summary.goal: Migrate planner-ui to use the same design system and component patterns as relay-dashboard, enabling direct code reuse and visual consistency across the agentworkforce package ecosystem.
in_scope: Copy CSS variables, theme config, and globals from relay-dashboard
Add Google Fonts (Outfit, Inter, IBM Plex Mono)
Migrate all components to Tailwind classes
Replace emoji icons with inline SVG
constraints: Must match relay-dashboard visual appearance exactly
Greenfield approach - replace all existing styles
Dark theme by default (Mission Control aesthetic)

acceptance_criteria.description: Tailwind CSS 4 installed with PostCSS, build succeeds
Typography uses Outfit (display), Inter (body), IBM Plex Mono (code)
All buttons use Tailwind classes matching relay-dashboard patterns
All forms use Tailwind classes with focus:ring-cyan-500 pattern
All modals use bg-bg-tertiary, border-border-subtle, shadow-modal
All cards use bg-bg-card, rounded-xl, border-border-subtle
All emoji icons replaced with inline SVG using currentColor
Dark theme functional with .theme-dark class on html
index.css reduced to <100 lines (only CSS variables and base resets)

summary.decision: Adopt Tailwind CSS 4, relay-dashboard CSS vars, dark theme, inline SVG icons. Greenfield - replace all existing planner-ui styles.

investigation.method: Browser inspection + Playwright screenshots comparing relay-dashboard (localhost:3888) and planner-ui (localhost:3000)

root_cause.summary: Tailwind utilities not generating - globals.css missing @config directive
evidence: CSS variables ARE defined correctly (--border-subtle: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06))
BUT computed borderColor is rgb(15, 23, 42) (not the variable value)
ZERO Tailwind utility rules exist in the stylesheet (.bg-*, .border-*, .text-* all return empty)
HTML has classes like border-border-subtle but no CSS rules are generated

issues_found.title: CSS variable naming convention mismatch
issues_found.impact: Tailwind config references var(--color-*) but CSS defines var(--*)

issues_found.title: Tailwind config structure mismatch
issues_found.required: relay-dashboard uses nested colors: { bg: { deep: 'var(--color-bg-deep)' }, text: { primary: 'var(--color-text-primary)' } }
issues_found.impact: Classes like bg-bg-deep won't work - need bg-deep with nested structure

issues_found.title: Light theme is default
issues_found.observation: Both repos default to light theme via :root, dark via .theme-dark or prefers-color-scheme

required_fixes.action: Rename all CSS variables from --name to --color-name to match relay-dashboard
Restructure colors from flat { 'bg-deep': ... } to nested { bg: { deep: ... } }

steps.title: Install Tailwind CSS 4 and PostCSS
steps.description: Install tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, postcss as dev dependencies. Create postcss.config.js with @tailwindcss/postcss plugin.

acceptance_criteria.description: npm run build succeeds without errors

steps.title: Create Tailwind config with relay-dashboard theme (NESTED STRUCTURE)
steps.description: Create tailwind.config.js copying EXACT structure from relay-dashboard. CRITICAL: Use NESTED color objects (bg: { deep, primary }, text: { primary, secondary }, border: { DEFAULT, subtle }, accent: { cyan, orange }) referencing CSS vars with --color-* prefix. Do NOT use flat structure like 'bg-deep': var(--bg-deep).

acceptance_criteria.description: tailwind.config.js exists with NESTED colors: { bg: { deep: 'var(--color-bg-deep)', primary: 'var(--color-bg-primary)', ... } }
text colors NESTED: { text: { primary: 'var(--color-text-primary)', secondary: 'var(--color-text-secondary)', ... } }
border colors NESTED: { border: { DEFAULT: 'var(--color-border-default)', subtle: 'var(--color-border-subtle)', ... } }
accent colors NESTED: { accent: { cyan: 'var(--color-accent-cyan)', orange: 'var(--color-accent-orange)', ... } }
theme.extend.fontFamily includes: display (Outfit), sans (Inter), mono (IBM Plex Mono)
theme.extend.boxShadow includes: glow-cyan, glow-orange, glow-purple, glow-green, modal

steps.title: Create globals.css with relay-dashboard CSS variables AND @config directive
steps.description: Create src/globals.css with complete CSS variable system from relay-dashboard. CRITICAL: Must include @config directive pointing to tailwind.config.js AFTER the @import 'tailwindcss' line. Use --color-* prefix for all variables (not --bg-*, --text-*).

acceptance_criteria.description: globals.css includes @import for Google Fonts: Outfit, Inter, IBM Plex Mono
.theme-dark class sets dark theme as default, .theme-light provides light variant

steps.title: Update index.html with fonts and theme class
steps.description: Add Google Fonts preconnect and stylesheet links to index.html. Add class='theme-dark' to html element for default dark theme.

acceptance_criteria.description: index.html has Google Fonts stylesheet link for Outfit, Inter, IBM Plex Mono

steps.title: Update main entry to import globals.css
steps.description: Update src/main.tsx to import './globals.css' instead of './index.css'. Verify app loads with new styling foundation.

acceptance_criteria.description: App renders with dark background (#0a0a0f) and light text (#f0f0f5)
Fonts visually load (Outfit for headings, Inter for body)

steps.title: Verify Tailwind utilities are generating
steps.description: BLOCKER CHECK: After fixing dsm-002 and dsm-003, verify that Tailwind utility classes are actually being generated. In browser devtools, check that classes like bg-bg-deep, text-text-primary, border-border-subtle have corresponding CSS rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: In browser devtools, document.styleSheets shows rules for .bg-bg-deep, .bg-bg-primary, etc.
An element with class='bg-bg-deep' has computed backgroundColor matching --color-bg-deep value
An element with class='border-border-subtle' has computed borderColor matching --color-border-subtle value
An element with class='text-text-primary' has computed color matching --color-text-primary value

steps.title: Create SVG icon components
steps.description: Create src/components/icons/ directory with inline SVG icon components matching relay-dashboard patterns: stroke-based, strokeWidth=2, fill=none, currentColor. Icons needed: CheckIcon, AlertIcon, LockIcon, MessageIcon, ChevronIcon, PlusIcon, TrashIcon, EditIcon, CloseIcon.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each icon accepts size prop (sm:14px, md:16px, lg:20px, xl:24px) and className
Each icon uses stroke='currentColor', strokeWidth='2', fill='none'
Icons: CheckIcon, AlertIcon, LockIcon, MessageIcon, ChevronIcon, PlusIcon, TrashIcon, EditIcon, CloseIcon exist

steps.title: Migrate Button components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert all button styles from .btn classes to Tailwind utilities. Pattern: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-all duration-150. Primary: bg-accent-cyan text-bg-deep hover:shadow-glow-cyan. Secondary: bg-bg-tertiary text-text-primary border border-border-default hover:border-border-light.

acceptance_criteria.description: All <button> elements use Tailwind classes, no .btn CSS classes

steps.title: Migrate Badge components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert all badge styles to Tailwind. Pattern: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide. Status badges use semantic colors from relay-dashboard.

acceptance_criteria.description: All badges use Tailwind classes, no .badge CSS classes
All badges: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide

steps.title: Migrate Form components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert form styles: inputs, textareas, selects, labels. Pattern: bg-bg-secondary border border-border-default rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-muted focus:border-accent-cyan focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-cyan/50.

acceptance_criteria.description: All inputs use Tailwind classes, no .form-group CSS

steps.title: Migrate Modal components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert modal/dialog styles. Overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50. Modal: bg-bg-tertiary border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl shadow-modal max-w-md mx-auto. Header: border-b border-border-subtle. Actions: flex gap-3 justify-end.

acceptance_criteria.description: Modal overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50

steps.title: Migrate Panel components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert ChatPanel and CommentThread panel styles. Pattern: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-[420px] bg-bg-secondary border-l border-border-subtle z-40 animate-slide-in-right.

acceptance_criteria.description: ChatPanel uses: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-[420px] bg-bg-secondary
Panel overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/30 z-30

steps.title: Migrate Card components to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert card styles for plan items, step items. Pattern: bg-bg-card border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-border-light transition-colors duration-150.

steps.title: Migrate Layout component to Tailwind
steps.description: Convert Layout, Header components. Header: h-header (52px) bg-bg-secondary border-b border-border-subtle. Main content area: bg-bg-primary min-h-screen.

steps.title: Replace emoji icons with SVG icons
steps.description: Replace all emoji usage with SVG icon components. Lock emoji → LockIcon, Warning emoji → AlertIcon, Comment emoji → MessageIcon, Checkmark → CheckIcon.

acceptance_criteria.description: GateApprovalCard uses LockIcon instead of lock emoji
ChangeRequestNotification uses AlertIcon instead of warning emoji
No emoji characters remain in component JSX

steps.title: Migrate remaining utility components
steps.description: Convert remaining components: LoadingSpinner, StepStatusIndicator, ExecutionProgress, Tabs, etc. to Tailwind classes.

acceptance_criteria.description: StepStatusIndicator: colored circles with status colors
Tabs: border-b border-border-subtle, active tab border-accent-cyan
All components use Tailwind, no remaining CSS class references

steps.title: Add animation keyframes to Tailwind config
steps.description: Add custom animations to tailwind.config.js: fade-in, slide-up, slide-down, slide-in-right, pulse-glow. Match relay-dashboard timing.

steps.title: Visual verification of all pages
steps.description: Manually verify all pages render correctly with new design system: PlansListPage, NewPlanPage, PlanEditorPage. Check dark theme, fonts, colors, spacing.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlansListPage: dark background, cards visible, badges correct colors
NewPlanPage: form inputs styled, tabs functional
PlanEditorPage: steps, panels, workflow all styled correctly

steps.title: Delete old index.css
steps.description: Remove the old src/index.css file (~3900 lines) now that all styles are in Tailwind. Verify no imports reference it.

steps.title: Final cleanup and review
steps.description: Final review of all changes. Remove any unused CSS variables. Ensure globals.css is minimal. Run linter and fix any issues.

acceptance_criteria.description: globals.css < 200 lines (only CSS variables and base resets)

cases.description: TypeScript compiles with no type errors

Render each icon component, expect svg element with stroke='currentColor'

cases.description: Focus states visible on interactive elements
